updates.text: The user said: "I spent Saturday morning at the DMV turning in my plates and signing the release-of-liability form—felt strange walking out without a registration card in my wallet."

The user said: "I finally caved and bought one of those tiny apartments with almost no storage—between the downsizing and the building’s strict clutter rules, I spent the weekend photographing everything I’m keeping and mailing the rest to my sister so I’m not tripping over boxes anymore."

The user said: "I’m still getting used to the rhythm here—badge check at the elevator, the nurses doing rounds, and visiting hours that cut off before dinner. They even gave me a little locker for my things so I’m not hauling a bag back and forth."

The user said: "This year I’ve been leaning into being more flexible—if a better opportunity comes up, I’m fine reshuffling my schedule so I can take it without feeling guilty."
